critical_code_review_comments: SignupSalon.jsx line 351-354 — the business-type button has TWO data-testid attributes on the same element (`data-testid={\`signup-type-${v}\`}` on line 351 AND `data-testid={\`business-type-${v}-button\`}` on line 353). React uses the LAST prop, so the DOM attribute is `business-type-{v}-button` and the older `signup-type-{v}` testid from iter-193 is effectively DEAD. Clean up by removing the duplicate line 351 attribute (or the redundant one on 353) to avoid confusing future tests. Both were requested at different times; standardise on one.

SignupSalon.jsx line 34 references `newbiz` and `form.newly_opened` inside `effNewbiz()` but the helper is defined before `newbiz` state on line 61 — hoisting works for function declaration but this is a `const` arrow via the JSX callsite; it's fine here but the definition ordering hurts readability. Consider moving `effNewbiz` after state declarations.

Badge string differs by business_type: 'First Month Free · No credit card · Cancel anytime' (resto) vs '{trialDays}-Day Free Trial · No credit card · Cancel anytime' (salon). Both render in uppercase via CSS `uppercase tracking` classes — visual result matches spec ('FIRST MONTH FREE' shouted form). ✓
